## The text

## What changes when PR #20572 lands (for N = 18)

- **`conversionIds`** is derived: `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[18]!.map(c => c.id)`. The author adds the conversion only to `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[18]`; there is no second list to edit.
- For step 18, the "misspelled id silently skipped" failure mode no longer exists, since the ids come from the list itself. It still applies to earlier steps.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Reword the checklist item for step 18: add a fragment at its sorted position, add the conversion only to `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[18]`, and the merge pin `packages/spec/scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` will refuse an unsorted append. Keep the old wording for earlier steps. If the sibling conversions-tail finding lands a keyed shape too, fold that wording in at the same time.
